lines.text: I am but a fool, look you, and yet I have the wit to think my master is a kind of a knave; but that's all one if he be but one knave. He lives not now that knows me to be in love, yet I am in love, but a team of horse shall not pluck that from me, nor who 'tis I love; and yet 'tis a woman, but what woman I will not tell myself; and yet 'tis a milkmaid; yet 'tis not a maid, for she hath had gossips; yet 'tis a maid, for she is her master's maid and serves for wages. She hath more qualities than a water-spaniel, which is much in a bare Christian. [Pulls out a paper.] Here is the cate-log of her condition. Imprimis, She can fetch and carry. Why, a horse can do no more; nay, a horse cannot fetch but only carry; therefore is she better than a jade. Item, She can milk. Look you, a sweet virtue in a maid with clean hands.

lines.plainText: Come fool come try me in thy paper

lines.text: [Gives him the paper.] There; and Saint Nicholas be thy speed.
lines.plainText: Gives him the paper There and Saint Nicholas be thy speed

lines.text: Imprimis, She can milk.
lines.plainText: Imprimis She can milk

lines.text: Ay, that she can.
lines.plainText: Ay that she can

lines.text: Item, She brews good ale.
lines.plainText: Item She brews good ale

lines.text: And thereof comes the proverb, "Blessing of your heart, you brew good ale."
lines.plainText: And thereof comes the proverb Blessing of your heart you brew good ale

lines.text: Item, She can sew.
lines.plainText: Item She can sew

lines.text: That's as much as to say, "Can she so?"
lines.plainText: That's as much as to say Can she so

lines.text: Item, She can knit.
lines.plainText: Item She can knit

lines.text: What need a man care for a stock with a wench, when she can knit him a stock?
lines.plainText: What need a man care for a stock with a wench when she can knit him a stock

lines.text: Item, She can wash and scour.
lines.plainText: Item She can wash and scour

lines.text: A special virtue, for then she need not be washed and scoured.
lines.plainText: A special virtue for then she need not be washed and scoured

lines.text: Item, She can spin.
lines.plainText: Item She can spin

lines.text: Then may I set the world on wheels, when she can spin for her living.
lines.plainText: Then may I set the world on wheels when she can spin for her living

lines.text: Item, She hath many nameless virtues.
lines.plainText: Item She hath many nameless virtues

lines.text: That's as much as to say, "bastard virtues", that indeed know not their fathers, and therefore have no names.
lines.plainText: That's as much as to say bastard virtues that indeed know not their fathers and therefore have no names

lines.text: Here follow her vices.
lines.plainText: Here follow her vices

lines.text: Close at the heels of her virtues.
lines.plainText: Close at the heels of her virtues

lines.text: Item, She is not to be kissed fasting in respect of her breath.
lines.plainText: Item She is not to be kissed fasting in respect of her breath

lines.text: Well, that fault may be mended with a breakfast.
lines.plainText: Well that fault may be mended with a breakfast

lines.text: Read on.
lines.plainText: Read on

lines.text: Item, She hath a sweet mouth.
lines.plainText: Item She hath a sweet mouth

lines.text: That makes amends for her sour breath.
lines.plainText: That makes amends for her sour breath

lines.text: Item, She doth talk in her sleep.
lines.plainText: Item She doth talk in her sleep

lines.text: It's no matter for that, so she sleep not in her talk.
lines.plainText: It's no matter for that so she sleep not in her talk

lines.text: Item, She is slow in words.
lines.plainText: Item She is slow in words

lines.text: O villain, that set this down among her vices! To be slow in words is a woman's only virtue. I pray thee, out with't, and place it for her chief virtue.
lines.plainText: O villain that set this down among her vices To be slow in words is a woman's only virtue I pray thee out with't and place it for her chief virtue

lines.text: Item, She is proud.
lines.plainText: Item She is proud

lines.text: Out with that too; it was Eve's legacy and cannot be ta'en from her.
lines.plainText: Out with that too it was Eve's legacy and cannot be ta'en from her

lines.text: Item, She hath no teeth.
lines.plainText: Item She hath no teeth

lines.text: I care not for that neither, because I love crusts.
lines.plainText: I care not for that neither because I love crusts

lines.text: Item, She is curst.
lines.plainText: Item She is curst

lines.text: Well, the best is, she hath no teeth to bite.
lines.plainText: Well the best is she hath no teeth to bite

lines.text: Item, She will often praise her liquor.
lines.plainText: Item She will often praise her liquor

lines.text: If her liquor be good, she shall; if she will not, I will, for good things should be praised.
lines.plainText: If her liquor be good she shall if she will not I will for good things should be praised

lines.text: Item, She is too liberal.
lines.plainText: Item She is too liberal

lines.text: Of her tongue she cannot, for that's writ down she is slow of; of her purse she shall not, for that I'll keep shut. Now, of another thing she may, and that cannot I help. Well, proceed.
lines.plainText: Of her tongue she cannot for that's writ down she is slow of of her purse she shall not for that I'll keep shut Now of another thing she may and that cannot I help Well proceed

lines.text: Item, She hath more hair than wit, and more faults than hairs, and more wealth than faults.
lines.plainText: Item She hath more hair than wit and more faults than hairs and more wealth than faults

lines.text: Stop there; I'll have her. She was mine and not mine twice or thrice in that last article. Rehearse that once more.
lines.plainText: Stop there I'll have her She was mine and not mine twice or thrice in that last article Rehearse that once more

lines.text: Item, She hath more hair than wit—
lines.plainText: Item She hath more hair than wit

lines.text: More hair than wit. It may be; I'll prove it: the cover of the salt hides the salt, and therefore it is more than the salt; the hair that covers the wit is more than the wit, for the greater hides the less. What's next?
lines.plainText: More hair than wit It may be I'll prove it the cover of the salt hides the salt and therefore it is more than the salt the hair that covers the wit is more than the wit for the greater hides the less What's next

lines.text: And more faults than hairs.
lines.plainText: And more faults than hairs

lines.text: That's monstrous! O, that that were out!
lines.plainText: That's monstrous O that that were out

lines.text: And more wealth than faults.
lines.plainText: And more wealth than faults

lines.text: Why, that word makes the faults gracious. Well, I'll have her; an if it be a match, as nothing is impossible—
lines.plainText: Why that word makes the faults gracious Well I'll have her an if it be a match as nothing is impossible

lines.text: What then?
lines.plainText: What then

lines.text: Why, then will I tell thee that thy master stays for thee at the North Gate.
lines.plainText: Why then will I tell thee that thy master stays for thee at the North Gate

lines.text: For me?
lines.plainText: For me

lines.text: For thee? Ay, who art thou? He hath stayed for a better man than thee.
lines.plainText: For thee Ay who art thou He hath stayed for a better man than thee

lines.text: And must I go to him?
lines.plainText: And must I go to him

lines.text: Thou must run to him, for thou hast stayed so long that going will scarce serve the turn.
lines.plainText: Thou must run to him for thou hast stayed so long that going will scarce serve the turn

lines.text: Why didst not tell me sooner? Pox of your love letters!
lines.plainText: Why didst not tell me sooner Pox of your love letters

lines.text: Now will he be swinged for reading my letter; an unmannerly slave, that will thrust himself into secrets. I'll after, to rejoice in the boy's correction.
lines.plainText: Now will he be swinged for reading my letter an unmannerly slave that will thrust himself into secrets I'll after to rejoice in the boy's correction
